IC1a feedback, output series, after the 1N3666, two at the IC1b inputs
input, after the 220k, IC1a input, supply
one 25V coupling cap at Q1, one 25V electrolytic at the 4.5V reference
25V tantalum: IC1a gain leg and output coupling
supply pass transistor, drawing says type unknown
4.5V reference buffer, drawing says type unknown
JFET used as the gain-control element; drawing says type unknown
dual op amp, IC1a and IC1b
